title: Value-profile support-overhang occupation measure
summary: The VP support-overhang idea changes the random object from price distance to price-axis occupation mass, using lower support and upper overhang to model repair path geometry.

mechanism.payer: holders selling near weak price-axis support or buyers trapped by upper overhang
mechanism.receiver: liquidity provider buying names with defended lower occupation mass and open upside path
mechanism.random_object: price-axis occupation measure built from intraday amount mass
mechanism.math_forced_insight: A value-domain factor should not compress the price-axis mass shape into only mean/sigma; support, overhang, voids, targets, and barriers are the useful objects.

evidence.boundary: The smoke is promising but full-window coverage was incomplete; below_cost_depth alone is a reverse/value-trap signal.

relations.note: The core object is成交额在价格轴上的占据测度.
Support/overhang defines target and barrier geometry for repair paths.
2024-01 smoke cannot substitute for full-window IS/OOS validation.
Naked below-cost depth was a negative signal in the smoke evidence.
Build future value-domain factors from occupation mass, target, barrier, and first-passage payoff.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve this node for value-domain, support/resistance, price-axis volume, or hitting-problem factors.
Do not use below-cost depth as a positive signal without lower support and no-break confirmation.
Treat support-minus-overhang as a research lead until full-window datamart coverage and cost evidence are available.
